A [[general elections in the United Kingdom|general election]] was held in the United Kingdom on 3 May 2029 to elect all 650 members of the [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]]. The governing [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] under Prime Minister [[Andy Burnham]] remained the largest party but lost its majority, winning 250 seats. [[Reform UK]], led by [[Nigel Farage]], came second with 147 seats and formed a minority [[coalition government]] with the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] led by [[Kemi Badenoch]], making Farage [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]].
